# MH-21 — View active hikes

**Business value:** 932

[Back to index](../README.md)

## User story

As an employee
I want to see all hikers who are currently registered as being on a hike
So that I can monitor their expected return times

## Notes

Hike information:

- destination (name)
- route (a text description, e.g. "via the Chiaretto lake"),
- intermediate passage points (possible intermediate points, e.g. "Viso Mozzo")
